configuration.scope: Ten changed physical integration CPPs; process-isolated selected parents

limitations: Single before/after samples; system drift and execution order are not controlled by ABBA.
Process seconds sum overlapping test process durations and are not elapsed wall time.
CTest real seconds come from each completed log; wrapper wall time is recorded separately.
Different parent counts reflect named subcases and benchmark migration, not equivalent process boundaries.
Known failures and skips remain; newly fatal warning assertions alter early-failure behavior.
The LSP parent exposes baseline warning-only oracle failures; it is not evidence of a new product regression.
The new imported-decal projection oracle has no equivalent baseline oracle; any failure is additional coverage.
These ten sources do not establish a complete integration-suite speedup or a cold-build/PDB improvement.
